title: Narra 4.1.34 — Critical Fix
message: Install 4.1.34 over your current Narra app to keep your library, downloads, and settings. This critical fix improves anime discovery and playback when AniList is unavailable, adds a backup release schedule, and improves TV updates and free-user ad placement.
changelog: Update over your current Narra app without uninstalling to keep local data.
Anime discovery and playback have a fallback when AniList returns HTTP 403.
The anime schedule has a backup weekly broadcast feed; backup times are estimates.
TV now checks for updates when opened or resumed and shows an update prompt.
Free-user browsing banners are better placed and recover after changing screens.
